## Où j'en suis
Built the dashboards_v2 grid on branch tom/dashboard-grid-v2: react-grid-layout drag/resize, layout persisted server-side with a localStorage fallback, widget sizing via a ResizeObserver hook, and v1 dashboards left untouched behind the flag. The Storybook build that had broken on CI was fixed by moving the grid CSS import into `.storybook/preview.ts`. Draft PR kestrel-analytics/platform#418 is open (last commit d2286a0), waiting on Priya's UX review.

- [en-cours] Draft PR #418 open; Priya's UX review still pending.
- [prochaine-étape] Priya's iPad UX review, then enabling dashboards_v2 for the Zest workspace before the Tuesday 24th demo.
- [essai-raté] CSS container queries for widget sizing — iOS 15 Safari ignores @container silently, so Zest's iPads stayed on the small layout.
- [décision] Layout persisted server-side via PUT /dashboards/:id/layout (source: t03)
- [décision] Container queries dropped entirely, one sizing system only (source: t09)
- [décision] dashboards_v2 on for Zest's workspace only; v1 dashboards stay until January (source: t15)
